messages:
lauren: FYI deploybot just blocked RC8->prod. SBOM integrity + transitive vuln hit the policy. Change window closes in ~2h. Need fast decision: pin digest, quick hotpatch, or rollback to rc7?

deploybot: deploybot: pipeline halted: policy 'supply-chain-integrity' triggered on artifact redwood-model-server:rc8. Details:
- SBOM: transitive package 'libfastsub' flagged CVE-2024-31245 (CVSS 6.1)
- Provenance: missing signature for layer 3 (builder did not sign)
Action: canary and prod promotions blocked. Console: <https://console.internal/releases/2468013579|open>

sanjay: Can we do a quick pin to an older base image digest? Which clusters are affected? cc @chris.qa

chris.qa: Affected: canary + prod. Canary promotion from rc7->rc8 failed during promote. If we pin the image we should be able to proceed to canary. Rolling back to rc7 would be safe but delays the release.

maria.sec: CVE-2024-31245 is medium severity and transitive. There is a backport patch available in libfastsub v2.1.1. Options:
1) Pin base image to a known-good digest (avoids pulling patched transitive dep)
2) Request exception for prod (requires legal & security acceptance)
3) Roll back to rc7 (safe, but blocks product schedule)
Recommendation: pin+canary so we can validate behavior, then re-bake signed image with patched deps.

lauren: Timeline: change window closes at 22:00 UTC. If security signoff not in ~45m we should roll back to rc7 to avoid schedule slippage. @maria.sec can you sign off quickly if pin avoids the vuln?

toni.legal: If we accept an exception for prod we need a documented risk acceptance and responsibility assignment for post-deploy mitigation. Who will own the follow-up patch?

sanjay: I can open a pin PR now to swap image tag -> digest. Small change to k8s manifests. ETA ~15m to PR and bake.

deploybot: deploybot: created ticket DL-4123 for pin PR by sanjay. Patch will trigger prebake job. Canary gating will remain until reviewer approves.

kevin: I'll review the PR right away. @maria.sec please confirm that the pin avoids the vulnerable transitive dep and doesn't reintroduce other issues.

maria.sec: Confirmed: pinning to sha256:abcd1234 prevents the new transitive libfastsub from being included. Note: provenance check still fails because the builder didn't sign that image; to restore the provenance gate we must re-bake with sigstore-signed layers (~40m). Pin fixes the vuln exposure but not the missing signature.

lauren: Given the clock, pin+canary + a mitigation plan (re-bake signed image in next change window) seems pragmatic. Approvals needed: security signoff for canary (maria.sec) and release-ops review (kevin).

maria.sec: I approve pin for canary only. No prod rollout until provenance is fixed or a documented exception is accepted by security lead + legal. Approved-by: maria.sec

kevin: PR reviewed and merged. Deploybot: canary promotion triggered.

deploybot: deploybot: canary deploy started for redwood-model-server@sha256:abcd1234. Monitoring SLO: 5m health window. Will post updates.

chris.qa: Running quick smoke now. Logs:
```
healthcheck: ok
latency_p95: 120ms
error_rate: 0.1%
```
No regressions observed in initial smoke.

lauren: :thumbsup: If canary stays green for 15m we can keep the release schedule and plan prod deploy in the next change window after we re-bake signed image. Legal wants written acceptance if we override any policies.

toni.legal: I'll draft the acceptance note and assign follow-up to infra for the re-bake.

maria.sec: Please open an issue to re-bake with signed provenance + apply the libfastsub 2.1.1 backport; tag security:urgent and assign to sanjay.

lauren: Thanks all. Closing this thread once prod remains gated. @deploybot please record the decision in the release notes and keep the canary status pinned in the pipeline.

deploybot: deploybot: canary passed at +18m. Prod deploy remains gated pending provenance fix. Release notes updated: <https://internal/release/notes/rc8|rc8 release notes>.
